sections.title: Overview
sections.body: YoYo Map is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.

sections.body: We collect only the information you voluntarily provide when adding yourself to the map.

sections.title: Data You Provide
sections.body: When you submit to the map, you may provide:
auto: Basic analytics (page views, no personal data)

sections.title: How We Use Your Data
sections.body: Your data is used to:
list: Display your pin on the map
Allow others to find and connect with you

sections.title: Data Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell or rent your personal information.

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.body: We retain your data until you request deletion.
list: You can request deletion at any time

Some data may be retained for legal purposes
Anonymized data may be retained for analytics
